items.subject: Re: a signal play for Tandem Labs
items.original_reply: Can you send over the detail on how the research step works? Specifically what it uses to pick the signal it opens on.
items.draft:
Good question, Priya — the research step reads three things per account: recent company news, the GTM stack we can detect from public signals, and open sales roles.

Whichever is strongest becomes the opener, so no two emails at Tandem Labs would look the same. Happy to walk through a live example on a call if that's useful.
demo_alternates:
Short version, Priya: news, detected GTM stack, and open sales roles. The strongest of the three becomes the opener.

I can show you the actual output for five of your accounts if that's more useful than an explanation.
items.rationale: Matches the info request intent; keeps the next step concrete and offers proof over persuasion.

items.subject: Re: a signal play for Aperture Robotics
items.original_reply: What does this cost at our size (roughly 12 reps)? If it's in range I'll loop in our RevOps lead.
items.draft:
Tomas — at 12 reps you'd be in our mid tier. Rather than quote blind, the honest answer is it depends on volume and how many personas you're targeting.

Happy to put real numbers in front of you and your RevOps lead on a short call — 20 minutes and you'd have a figure you can plan against.
demo_alternates:
Tomas — 12 reps puts you in the mid tier. I'd rather give you a real number than a range, which needs 20 minutes on volume and persona count.

Want me to include your RevOps lead so pricing and attribution get covered together?
items.rationale: Matches the pricing intent; keeps the next step concrete and offers proof over persuasion.
